content.short: Immunefi is an advanced decentralized protocol designed for seamless web3 security competitions within the Web3 ecosystem on Ethereum and others.
content.description: Immunefi is a bug bounty platform for smart contracts. Built organically for the Web3 ecosystem, Immunefi provides an essential suite of services focused heavily on web3 security competitions. By operating on Ethereum and Polygon and BNB Chain, it allows users to experience fast execution times while maintaining strong cryptographic security. The protocol is designed to be highly interoperable, aiming to become a cornerstone of the Web3 Security Tools sector. Through continuous innovation, Immunefi contributes to the broader vision of a decentralized, permissionless digital economy.
